theorems.name: Submission.p03_eds_canonical_even_recurrence_68cf3476_d4
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), let q := WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk W.toAffine; let h := q W.ψ₂; let F : ℕ → W.toAffine.CoordinateRing := fun n => q (Polynomial.C (W.preΨ' n)) * (if Even n then h else 1); ∀ r : ℕ, 3 ≤ r → h * F (2 * r) = F r * (F (r + 2) * F (r - 1) ^ 2 - F (r - 2) * F (r + 1) ^ 2)
